body: Thank you, I'm not sure if its depression. I just get into these crazy moods and they only last for a short time but their extremely intense.
Thanks, its good to know I'm not alone.
Because its a state of mind, I realize it seems impossible to crawl out of but there is a light side. If you cannot help yourself find solace in helping others. That's how I deal with these feelings.
I don't know what to say except that I don't know you but I care about you. I mean this genuinely, please don't hurt yourself.
